runtimeModel: NativeAOT user process with guideXOS PAL and private workstation GC

externalSymbolBudget.policy: Every symbol has a documented purpose, a future guideXOS implementation, and process-isolation semantics. No Windows ABI name is admitted.

categories.name: vm
categories.semantics: Process-local page operations. Inputs and outputs are user-process addresses; the kernel owns validation and page-table authority.

symbols.name: guidexos_pal_vm_reserve
symbols.purpose: Reserve process-local virtual address space without creating executable pages.
symbols.futureImplementation: Bounded Ring 3 VM reserve ABI; no kernel VA or cross-process authority.

symbols.name: guidexos_pal_vm_commit
symbols.prototype: int32_t (void* address, uint64_t size, uint32_t protection)
symbols.purpose: Commit user pages with explicit R/RW/RX protection.
symbols.futureImplementation: Process-owned page mapping through the bounded VM ABI; reject RWX.

symbols.name: guidexos_pal_vm_protect
symbols.prototype: int32_t (void* address, uint64_t size, uint32_t protection)
symbols.purpose: Change protection on already-owned process pages.
symbols.futureImplementation: Validated process-local page-table update; no kernel mappings.

symbols.name: guidexos_pal_vm_release
symbols.purpose: Release a reservation and its process-owned pages.
symbols.futureImplementation: Generation-owned Ring 3 VM teardown with deterministic failure.

symbols.name: guidexos_pal_vm_query
symbols.prototype: int32_t (void* address, uint64_t* base, uint64_t* size, uint32_t* protection)
symbols.purpose: Return bounded attributes only when the runtime requires a query.
symbols.futureImplementation: Read-only query against the current process address-space descriptor.

categories.name: tls_fls
categories.semantics: Process-private runtime blocks and scheduler-preserved thread-private state; no Windows handle emulation.

symbols.name: guidexos_pal_tls_initialize
symbols.prototype: int32_t (void* process_state, uint64_t template_size, uint64_t zero_size)
symbols.purpose: Initialize the process runtime TLS template and private block bookkeeping.
symbols.futureImplementation: Runtime-owned process state initialized from the loader descriptor.

symbols.name: guidexos_pal_tls_current_block
symbols.purpose: Return the current managed thread's private runtime block.
symbols.futureImplementation: Scheduler-managed user-thread transition state, not a scheduler object pointer.

symbols.name: guidexos_pal_fls_alloc
symbols.purpose: Allocate one bounded runtime FLS slot.
symbols.futureImplementation: Process-local slot table with cleanup at user-thread termination.

symbols.name: guidexos_pal_fls_get
symbols.purpose: Read a value from the current thread's FLS block.
symbols.futureImplementation: Validated slot lookup in the current runtime block.

symbols.name: guidexos_pal_fls_set
symbols.purpose: Write a value to the current thread's FLS block.
symbols.futureImplementation: Process/thread-private write with generation-safe cleanup.

symbols.name: guidexos_pal_fls_cleanup
symbols.purpose: Run and clear current-thread FLS cleanup during termination.
symbols.futureImplementation: Called by the user-thread termination path before the process generation is reclaimed.

categories.name: thread_identity
categories.semantics: Stable user-runtime identity is separate from kernel scheduler object addresses.

symbols.name: guidexos_pal_thread_id
symbols.purpose: Return a stable integer identity for the current managed user thread.
symbols.futureImplementation: Generation-scoped scheduler-assigned user-thread ID copied into runtime state.

symbols.name: guidexos_pal_thread_stack_bounds
symbols.purpose: Return the current user stack bounds for runtime bookkeeping.
symbols.futureImplementation: Bounded user-stack descriptor supplied by process/thread startup.

symbols.name: guidexos_pal_thread_runtime_state
symbols.purpose: Return the private runtime-thread state pointer.
symbols.futureImplementation: Pointer to a user-owned runtime structure, never a kernel scheduler pointer.

categories.name: time
categories.semantics: Small scalar primitives; no Windows FILETIME, timer handle, or wait-object surface.

symbols.name: guidexos_pal_monotonic_ticks
symbols.purpose: Read a monotonic high-resolution counter.
symbols.futureImplementation: Bounded read-only time ABI with no user pointer.

symbols.name: guidexos_pal_monotonic_frequency
symbols.purpose: Return the counter frequency.
symbols.futureImplementation: Fixed platform contract or bounded kernel-provided scalar.

symbols.name: guidexos_pal_system_time_ns
symbols.purpose: Return wall/system time in nanoseconds when runtime semantics require it.
symbols.futureImplementation: Bounded system-time scalar; no calendar or timezone PAL.

categories.name: entropy
categories.semantics: Caller supplies a process-owned buffer; the eventual ABI validates the user range and never returns a constant stream.

symbols.name: guidexos_pal_random_bytes
symbols.purpose: Fill bounded process-local storage with cryptographically appropriate entropy.
symbols.futureImplementation: Kernel entropy source exposed through a validated user buffer; failure is explicit.

categories.name: termination
categories.semantics: Runtime failure terminates the current process generation and cannot panic or mutate the kernel runtime.

symbols.name: guidexos_pal_process_exit
symbols.purpose: Terminate a managed process with its final status.
symbols.futureImplementation: Existing Ring 3 Exit/process cleanup path.

symbols.name: guidexos_pal_fail_fast
symbols.purpose: Terminate on unsupported runtime startup or fatal managed failure.
symbols.futureImplementation: Existing process-fault/Exit semantics with bounded diagnostic data; no kernel panic.

localHelpers.name: guidexos_pal_strlen
localHelpers.purpose: Process-local bounded C-string length helper when emitted code requires it.

synchronization.initialPolicy: Compiler/CPU atomics remain user-space. No external wait/event/critical-section symbol is admitted until generated evidence proves blocking synchronization is unavoidable.
synchronization.deferredPrimitive: A minimal process-local wait/wake ABI may be added later only with an emitted-use manifest and bounded user-thread semantics.

ownership.writableStatics: Private to the user process generation.
ownership.gc: Retain NativeAOT workstation GC if source adaptation permits; all GC heap, statics, frozen objects, write-barrier state, and VM pages remain process-private.
ownership.tls: Private to the process and current scheduler-managed user thread; never reuse kernel global TLS or scheduler object pointers.
ownership.module: Statically linked first payload; no DLL loading or import resolver in Phase 19.
ownership.exceptions: Keep required unwind metadata; unsupported managed exception semantics may fail-fast the process.
